The social club wants a printout of the competitor names and points totals after each game in
rank order (highest points total first).
To do this, Alessio writes a pseudocode procedure:
PROCEDURE SortIntoRankOrder
REPEAT
NoMoreSwaps ← TRUE
FOR x ← 1 TO 9
IF PointsTotal[x] < PointsTotal[x + 1]
THEN
NoMoreSwaps ← FALSE
Temp ← PointsTotal[x]
PointsTotal[x] ← PointsTotal[x + 1]
PointsTotal[x + 1] ← Temp
ENDIF
ENDFOR
UNTIL NoMoreSwaps = TRUE
ENDPROCEDURE
